name: lead-signals
description: Watch companies, buyers and topics; once a day, report only new EU tenders, register changes and sanctions matches, with source URLs and run ids. Runs on Ahel, pay per result.

interface.shortDescription: Daily new tenders, register changes and sanctions hits
interface.longDescription: Give a watch list of companies (with registry numbers), public buyers and tender topics. Once a day the skill checks TED, the official business registers and sanctions lists through Ahel, compares with what it has already seen, and writes a short Markdown report of only the new signals, each with its source URL and run id.
defaultPrompt: Watch new software tenders in Estonia and Bolt Technology OÜ (EE 12417834); report what is new every weekday morning.
Set up a daily lead-signals watch for the companies in targets.csv.
